title: Tokens & security
description: Manage API credentials and browser sessions; change your password and profile under Account settings.

profile.description: Review account details, change your display name and password.
profile.displayNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to show your username
profile.displayNameHint: Up to 64 characters; empty shows your username.
profile.tooLong: Display name must be at most 64 characters
profile.avatarNote: Your avatar comes from the site-wide avatar service matched by account email; the local default is shown when it is missing or fails to load. Your raw email address is never sent to the avatar service.
profile.error: Unable to save your profile. Try again later.

name: Name
expiryInvalid: Expiry must be in the future
creationHint: Web tokens are browser sessions issued at sign-in. Tokens created here have the api type and all permissions (*). The secret is shown only once after creation.
empty: No tokens yet. Create one above for API access.
revokeWarning: This token will stop working immediately. Revocation cannot be undone.
saveWarning: You cannot view this token again after closing. Save it now.
copyError: Copy failed. Select the token and copy it manually.
securityHint: Changing your password revokes every token and browser session. You will need to sign in again.

password.currentTooLong: Current password must be at most 72 bytes
password.tooShort: New password must be at least 12 bytes
password.tooLong: New password must be at most 72 bytes
password.success: Password changed. Please sign in again.
password.error: Unable to change password. Try again later.

integration.title: PicGo / Lsky setup
integration.description: Use an API token with a client that supports Lsky Pro v2 uploads.
integration.instructions: Use this site as the server address. Upload with POST and the multipart/form-data file field. If your client asks for an authorization header, replace YOUR_API_TOKEN in the example below with your saved API token.
integration.privacy: Enter tokens only in clients you trust. Keep them out of URLs, screenshots, and public configuration.
integration.availability: An administrator must enable the Lsky compatibility API. Native token management remains available when it is disabled.
